answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake that vests slowly and is slashed when fake identities are proven. Like a nebula condensing into stars, trust should form only through sustained, verifiable work, not instant self-declaration. A lone island of fake accounts cannot afford the stake for thousands of identities, while honest agents earn theirs back through completed jobs. A sable-dark audit trail links each identity to its stake and work history, so a sybil cluster sharing funding or behaviour is exposed and its stakes are burned together.
